newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London static as Europe takes break.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London static as Europe takes break.

text.p: U.S. shares were at a virtual standstill on Thursday due to the closure of most European financial markets in observance of the May Day holiday.
"We haven't done a single bargain this morning. Over eighty percent of our business comes from the continent(continental Europe) which is shut," one market maker said.
On Wednesday, the Dow Industrials Average closed above the 7,000 level for the first time in seven weeks, ending 46.96 points higher to 7,008.99.
The June T-bond was unchanged at 109-10/32 while the yield on the 30-year long bond stood at 6.96 percent by 1020 GMT.
The June S&P 500 futures contract was up 0.45 to 803.25.
